source_zh: 舒适型家庭住房：单成人+孩子按3BR，双成人+孩子按4BR。
source_en: Comfortable family baseline: 3BR for one adult plus kids, 4BR for two adults plus kids.

source_zh: 纽约按 Manhattan/近核心区家庭型住房的高成本假设。
source_en: New York assumes a high-cost Manhattan / near-core family baseline.

source_zh: 西雅图按高薪科技城市但住房仍偏贵的规划假设。
source_en: Seattle assumes a high-income tech city with still-elevated housing costs.

source_zh: 洛杉矶按大都会区改善型家庭成本估算。
source_en: Los Angeles assumes a metro-area family planning baseline.

source_zh: 达拉斯按较低住房成本、较强车依赖的家庭假设。
source_en: Dallas assumes lower housing costs and more car-dependent family spending.

source_zh: 上海改善型家庭长租：3居与4居分开，不再把双成人总支出翻倍。
source_en: Shanghai uses a family-friendly rental baseline and does not double total spending for two adults.

source_zh: 杭州舒适型改善住房：3居约$1.4k/月，4居约$1.8k/月；成人2增加的是边际成本。
source_en: Hangzhou uses comfortable-upgrade housing assumptions with incremental second-adult costs.

source_zh: 苏州相对杭州住房和日常生活成本略低。
source_en: Suzhou is modeled slightly below Hangzhou for housing and everyday expenses.

source_zh: 成都改善型3–4居室假设；金融城/高新区会更高。
source_en: Chengdu uses a 3-4BR improvement baseline; Finance City / Hi-tech zones can be higher.

source_zh: 昆明生活成本较低，住房按改善型3–4居室。
source_en: Kunming has lower living costs and a comfortable 3-4BR housing baseline.

source_zh: 大理旅游属性强，长期租金波动更大。
source_en: Dali has stronger tourism effects and more volatile long-term rent.

source_zh: 海口按改善型家庭长租；新片区差异较大。
source_en: Haikou uses an improved-family rental baseline with area-level variation.

source_zh: 太原按改善型3–4居室，不使用豪宅挂牌作为默认。
source_en: Taiyuan uses a comfortable 3-4BR baseline and avoids luxury-listing defaults.
